en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4653 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"It is recommended for a man to approach his wife on the first night of the month of Ramadan because of the saying of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic:
'It has been made lawful for you to be intimate with your wives during the nights of fasting' (Surah Al-Baqarah 2:187),
